name: Addy
reason: The official page describes an agentic development environment with parallel agents and persistent context, but it is notify-only and provides no dated release, install path, documentation, or source repository.

name: Agent Harness (Agent Software)
reason: The vendor documents an execution layer for AI coding workflows, but its current official release-state report says Agent Harness remains in development and does not identify a released package or repository.

name: @ai-sdk-tool/harness
reason: npm metadata now resolves the package to github.com/minpeter/plugsuits/packages/harness, but the official monorepo is archived and declares no repository license; keep deferred until a maintained, licensable source or successor is published.

name: ClawDE
reason: The official page describes a host-first multi-agent development environment with local execution, shared context, drift checks, and cross-device sessions, but it is still marked early access and only offers launch notification rather than a public download or source repository.

name: Decispher
reason: The founder's launch post describes a context engine, persistent memory plane, sandboxed worker agent, and npm setup commands, but it does not link an official product, documentation, package, or repository page that could independently verify the released artifact.
